## alice-llm-model-warmup (PROJ-99)

Schedule 05:00 UTC (= 07:00 Europe/Berlin MESZ / 06:00 MEZ), i.e. after the
nightly DMS run (02:00 UTC, loads mistral) and before the working day.

Fires ONE tiny /v1/chat/completions request against the chat model so the
llama.cpp router loads qwen (evicting mistral, --models-max 1) — the first
real chat of the day then has no cold-load delay.

The llama.cpp router has no idle-unload (replaces Ollama OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1),
so once warmed qwen stays resident until the next night's mistral request.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3-vl-30b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ping' }], stream: false, max_tokens: 1 }) }}
